children.text: Opening and Event Details
children.cn: 开篇与活动详情

children.text: Dear Mr. Smith,
children.cn: 亲爱的史密斯先生，
children.notes: Dear + 称呼，书信常用称呼语。
children.explanation: 书信以 Dear 开头，礼貌问候收信人。

children.text: I'm glad to tell you about our English drama show.
children.cn: 很高兴向您告知我们的英语戏剧展示活动。
children.notes: be glad to do sth = 高兴做某事
children.statement: 这句话用来表达写信者的喜悦之情并引出正文。
children.explanation: be glad to do 是书信常用的开场白结构。

children.text: It will take place in the school hall this Friday afternoon from 2:00 to 5:00.
children.cn: 它将于本周五下午2点到5点在学校礼堂举行。
children.statement: 这句话交代了活动的时间和地点。
children.explanation: 用具体的时间和地点回答了 When and where 的问题。

children.text: Activities and Help Needed
children.cn: 活动安排与寻求帮助

children.text: Students will wear nice clothes and perform different roles in interesting plays.
children.cn: 学生们将穿着漂亮的衣服，在有趣的戏剧中扮演不同的角色。
children.notes: wear clothes = 穿衣服; perform roles =扮演角色
children.statement: 这句话介绍了戏剧展示活动的具体内容。
children.explanation: 提到了提示词 clothes, role, perform。

children.text: We also want to give a short speech at the beginning.
children.cn: 我们还想在开场时做一个简短的演讲。
children.statement: 这句话包含了提示词 speech。
children.explanation: 展示了活动安排的另一部分内容。

children.text: Could you please give us some advice on our spoken English?
children.cn: 您能就我们的英语口语给我们一些建议吗？
children.notes: give advice on = 就...给出建议
children.statement: 这句话向外教 Mr. Smith 寻求帮助。
children.explanation: 使用了提示词 advice，委婉地寻求外教的指导。

children.text: Closing
children.cn: 结尾

children.text: I'm looking forward to your reply.
children.cn: 我期待您的回复。
children.notes: look forward to doing sth = 期待做某事
children.statement: 这句话是书信的标准结尾客套话。
children.explanation: 表达了对收信人回复的期盼。

children.text: Yours, Li Hua
children.cn: 谨上，李华
children.notes: Yours, = 您的（署名前的敬语）
children.explanation: Yours 后面接逗号，然后写上发信人名字。

children.text: Opening and Event Announcement
children.cn: 开篇与活动预告

children.text: Dear Mr. Smith,
children.cn: 亲爱的史密斯先生，
children.notes: Dear Mr. Smith 是正式的书信称呼。
children.explanation: 向收信人致以亲切而礼貌的问候。

children.text: I'm writing to sincerely invite you to our upcoming English drama show, which will be held in the school hall.
children.cn: 我写信真诚地邀请您参加我们即将举行的英语戏剧展演，该活动将在学校礼堂举办。
children.notes: sincerely = 真诚地; upcoming = 即将到来的; which引导非限制性定语从句
children.statement: 这句话使用了定语从句使表达更加丰富高级。
children.explanation: 通过 which 引导的定语从句补充了礼堂这一地点信息。

children.text: It is scheduled for this Friday afternoon from 2:00 to 5:00.
children.cn: 活动定于本周五下午2点至5点举行。
children.statement: 这句话准确地交代了活动的具体时间。
children.explanation: 使用 be scheduled for 替换了普通的 will take place，表达更地道。

children.text: Activities and Request for Assistance
children.cn: 活动安排与寻求帮助

children.text: During the show, students wearing traditional clothes will lively perform different roles in various plays.
children.cn: 演出期间，身着传统服饰的学生们将在各种戏剧中生动地扮演不同的角色。
children.notes: wearing traditional clothes 为现在分词作后置定语
children.statement: 这句话运用了分词作定语，紧凑地包含了 clothes, perform 和 role 三个提示词。
children.explanation: 传统分词短语使句子结构更加精炼。

children.text: In addition, some students will give an inspiring speech before the performances start.
children.cn: 此外，一些学生将在演出开始前发表鼓舞人心的演讲。
children.notes: In addition = 此外; inspiring = 鼓舞人心的
children.statement: 这句话包含了提示词 speech 并且运用了过渡词 In addition。
children.explanation: In addition 作为连接词，使上下文逻辑更加连贯。

children.text: As we want to make the show a great success, we would be extremely grateful if you could give us some professional advice on our pronunciation and acting.
children.cn: 由于我们想让演出取得巨大成功，如果您能就我们的发音和表演给我们一些专业的建议，我们将感激不尽。
children.notes: As引导原因状语从句; be grateful if... = 如果...我们将感激不尽
children.statement: 这句话使用了复杂的从句结构向外教寻求帮助。
children.explanation: 包含了提示词 advice，并通过虚拟语气和条件状语从句显得十分礼貌。

children.text: Closing and Sign-off
children.cn: 结尾与落款

children.text: I'm really looking forward to hearing from you soon.
children.cn: 我真的非常期待能尽快收到您的回复。
children.notes: look forward to doing sth = 期待做某事
children.statement: 这句话表达了强烈的期待。
children.explanation: 用 really 和 soon 增强了期盼的语气。
children.keywords: looking forward to, hearing from you

children.text: Yours sincerely, Li Hua
children.cn: 谨上，李华
children.notes: Yours sincerely 是对不太熟悉但尊重的长辈/老师常用的正式落款。
children.statement: 这是更为正式的书信落款方式。
children.explanation: 比普通的 Yours 更加正式，适合写给外教。
